title: Example 17 Unsteady Flood Routing
notes: This case exercises multi-reach unsteady routing and junction handling.
The exact same-project steady prerequisite for the Diamond geometry is still a planned gap and has not been registered as a validated steady asset.

This case is also blocked by first-principles feature gaps around storage areas, storage-area connections, and lateral-structure-to-storage exchange, so it must not be treated as an ordinary network patch target.
